mapper.select: SELECT d.driver_contact, d.driver_birthdate, d.driver_lon, d.driver_lat, d.created_at, d.driver_name, d.driver_idx, d.driver_img, d.driver_gender, a.admin_name, c.car_number, COUNT(l.car_number) AS count_log FROM tb_driver d LEFT JOIN tb_admin a ON d.admin_idx = a.admin_idx LEFT JOIN tb_car c ON d.driver_idx = c.driver_idx LEFT JOIN tb_log l ON l.car_number = c.car_number WHERE d.admin_idx IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.driver_idx, d.driver_contact, d.driver_birthdate, d.driver_lon, d.driver_lat, d.created_at, a.admin_name, c.car_number
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_driver WHERE admin_idx IS NOT NULL
SELECT * FROM tb_driver WHERE admin_idx IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_driver WHERE admin_idx IS NULL
SELECT * FROM tb_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT l.*, d.driver_idx FROM tb_log l LEFT JOIN tb_car c ON l.car_number = c.car_number LEFT JOIN tb_driver d ON c.driver_idx = d.driver_idx ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_log WHERE YEAR(created_at) = YEAR('2025-10-20') GROUP BY event_type
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_log WHERE MONTH(created_at) = MONTH('2025-10-20') AND YEAR(created_at) = YEAR('2025-10-20') GROUP BY event_type
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_log WHERE YEARWEEK(created_at, 1) = YEARWEEK('2025-10-20', 1) GROUP BY event_type
SELECT d.*, c.car_number, c.car_type FROM tb_driver d LEFT JOIN tb_car c ON d.driver_idx = c.driver_idx WHERE admin_idx = #{adminIdx}

SELECT d.*, c.car_number, c.car_type FROM tb_driver d LEFT JOIN tb_car c ON d.driver_idx = c.driver_idx WHERE d.driver_name LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{q}, '%') OR c.car_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR c.car_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR CAST(d.driver_idx AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(l.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS ym, l.event_type AS eventType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_log l WHERE l.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY ym, eventType ORDER BY ym ASC, eventType ASC

SELECT l.*, d.driver_name, d.driver_idx, d.driver_lat, d.driver_lon FROM tb_log l INNER JOIN tb_car c ON l.car_number = c.car_number INNER JOIN tb_driver d ON c.driver_idx = d.driver_idx ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT 12;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'Phone' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalP,
SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'Hand' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalH,
SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'Drowsy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalD,
SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'Assault' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalA FROM tb_log;

SELECT l.log_idx AS logIdx, DATE_FORMAT(l.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, l.car_number AS carNumber, d.driver_name AS driverName, l.event_type AS eventType, l.event_level AS eventLevel FROM tb_log l LEFT JOIN tb_car c ON l.car_number = c.car_number LEFT JOIN tb_driver d ON c.driver_idx = d.driver_idx ORDER BY l.log_idx ASC

SELECT l.log_idx AS logIdx, DATE_FORMAT(l.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, l.car_number AS carNumber, d.driver_name AS driverName, l.event_type AS eventType, l.event_level AS eventLevel, l.event_video AS eventVideo FROM tb_log l LEFT JOIN tb_car c ON l.car_number = c.car_number LEFT JOIN tb_driver d ON c.driver_idx = d.driver_idx WHERE l.log_idx = #{logIdx}
